An '''earbud comlink''',<ref name="GOI" /> also called an '''ear comlink'''<ref name="HH" /> or '''earpiece''',<ref name="MandalorePlot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> was a short-ranged [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that was fitted for the user's [[Ear/Legends|ear]]. It was designed to provide unobtrusive and discreet private communication. It was often used by spies, card cheats and ambassadors. It could be programmed to initiate communication when the wearer would touch their ear, grind their teeth or click their jaw.<ref name="GOI" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] used one to maintain contact with her accomplice, [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], during an [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|operation]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="HH" />
